visual_standard: Journal width, white background, thin horizontal rules, one blue accent, direct labels, and color-independent state codes. Titles, source notes, uncertainty, and interpretation belong in manuscript captions.

figures.title: Public-case selection and stopping
figures.sample: 928 preserved candidate records; the first five AIID records were screened
figures.transformation: Read collection counts and frozen candidate order, count selected and excluded decisions, and calculate unscreened candidate records as 928 minus 5.
figures.claim_supported: The frozen procedure filled three prespecified strata after five screenings and left the remaining candidate records unscreened.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The diagram supplies no estimate of prevalence, representativeness, or exclusion rate among all 928 candidate records.

figures.title: Practical-control states across three public cases
figures.unit_of_analysis: practical-control proposition within a public case
figures.sample: 27 declared states from 9 propositions across 3 purposefully selected cases
figures.transformation: Extract each practical_control state in protocol order and render the declared categorical state without assigning a numeric score.
figures.claim_supported: The current assessment set separates authority evidence from the conditions that give authority practical force. The strict v0.6.0 rule classifies the retrospective Oko evidence as partial across every pre-action stage.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The matrix supplies no frequency, effect-size, causal, reliability, or population estimate.

figures.title: Bounded decision paths and public evidence gaps
figures.unit_of_analysis: reconstructed event within a bounded case sequence
figures.transformation: Transcribe the five bounded chronology stages declared for each case and place them in relative event order.
figures.claim_supported: The public record identifies where a human judgment entered each sequence and where missing records constrain further inference.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: Horizontal spacing has no elapsed-time scale. The ZG710 packet alone supplies an approximate one-minute decision window.

figures.title: Trust-evidence states across three public cases
figures.unit_of_analysis: trust-evidence proposition within a public case
figures.sample: 36 declared states from 12 propositions across 3 purposefully selected cases
figures.transformation: Extract each trust_evidence state in register order and render the declared categorical state without assigning a numeric score.
figures.claim_supported: The three packets contain enough evidence for bounded findings while leaving reliability, uncertainty, integrity, and other propositions limited.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The matrix supplies no aggregate trust score and no claim that one system is generally safer or more trustworthy.

figures.title: Formal search retrieval and preliminary screening
figures.sample: 2,431 deduplicated records retrieved through direct queries and citation chains
figures.transformation: Sum direct-query and citation-chain retrieval counts, preserve the pooled and deduplicated totals, plot preliminary screening counts on a declared logarithmic axis, and calculate the open author queue as 12 retain-close plus 77 attention records.
figures.claim_supported: The open-index search produced a declared record pool and a visible author-decision gate. Eighty-nine substantive screening decisions remain open.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The preliminary triage is not a completed systematic review, and the search supplies no universal originality claim.

figures.title: Prespecified mutation responses
figures.unit_of_analysis: mutation delta assertion or invariance condition
figures.sample: 12 mutation tests containing 11 delta assertions and 3 invariance tests
figures.transformation: Compare expected and observed assessment deltas by mutation and field, then plot the resulting state or the preserved invariance condition.
figures.claim_supported: The committed assessment code changes the declared fields under the prespecified mutations and preserves three declared invariances.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The test establishes internal contract behavior for author-designed fixtures. It supplies no inter-rater or field-validity estimate.

figures.title: Reproducibility lineage
figures.sample: 11 artifact classes connected by 10 declared lineage edges
figures.transformation: Render the declared research and figure-generation artifact graph in process order and record hashes for the committed publication artifacts.
figures.claim_supported: A reader can trace plotted states from preserved inputs through assessments, derived tables, rendered files, and integrity checks.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: Hashes and reproducible transformations establish integrity and traceability. They do not establish the truth or completeness of the source content.

figures.title: Versioned correction of the Oko practical-control states
figures.sample: 6 propositions reassessed under the frozen v0.6.0 evidence rule
figures.transformation: Read each prior and current state from the correction ledger and draw the recorded version transition without changing the source packet.
figures.claim_supported: All six Oko pre-action states moved from supported to partially supported when the frozen direct-and-contemporaneous rule was applied to the existing packet.
figures.prohibited_interpretation: The figure records a method-driven correction. It supplies no new historical evidence and no estimate of error frequency.
